newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB skirmishes with cable companies-paper.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB skirmishes with cable companies-paper.

text.p: Fresh hostilities have broken out between satellite broadcaster BSkyB and British cable operators with each side accusing the other of spreading disinformation and misleading customers, the Independent newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Complaints by International CableTel Inc and another cable operator have been lodged with the Independent Television Commission (ITC), accusing BSkyB of a "dirty tricks" campaign aimed at convincing customers to switch to satellite, said the paper.
BSkyB has responded with similar charges, accusing cable operators of spreading misleading information about the Sky multi-channel package, it said.
The ITC has written to all British cable operators, asking them to respond to BSkyB's charges by January 24.
